verdict.rationale: Trello's own marketing states it can automate tasks and workflows, so first-party automation exists. The pack never describes trigger-and-action rules, how they are built, or what triggers and actions are available. Power-Up board buttons and REST webhooks are developer building blocks, not the rule builder itself, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented rule builder with triggers and actions, examples of eliminating repetitive steps, plan limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Automate tasks and workflows with Trello.
